pr_title: Update `gh attestation verify` bundle parsing and validation errors
pr_body:
<!--

Closes https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/9615

This updates the content of the error messages printed when parsing bundle files with either `.json` or `.jsonl` extensions. If bundle validation fails, the error message will now be more specific and informative.

issue_context.title: Update `gh attestation verify` bundle validation error content should be more specific
issue_context.body: The error handling in `gh attestation verify` when validating bundles should return specific messages so the user can more easily debug why validation is failing.

review_comments: It looks like `loadBundlesFromJSONLinesFile` wraps the error it gets back from `os.ReadFile`, so I think we might want to unwrap that, or do different error handling here.
